'''2014 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Mike Richards LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2014 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion]]
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
